claims.statement: It was rumored that Tom Allen had received a dispatch from Billy Madden asking him to select training quarters for Charley Mitchell, who was matched to fight Slade.
claims.excerpt: It was rumored last night that Tom Allen the ex-champion, had received a dispatet from Billy Madden of New York requestins

claims.statement: Tom Allen was called the ex-champion.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen the ex-champion, had received a dispatet

notes: Rumour only; the headline says 'Only a Remor' (rumour). The fight location and Mitchell's training place are not Allen's claims and are left out. The paper's 'this city' is St. Louis per the hints but not named in the text.
